items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Well, that was Nat Toll's Creole Harmony Kings, a group of New Orleans musicians.

ctx.x: Herb, what was the first band with which you left New Orleans? Well, that was Nat Toll's Creole Harmony Kings, a group of New Orleans musicians. We had an engagement to go to Tulsa, Oklahoma, play at the Nails Brothers Pavilion, a colored pavilion there. And after we played there a couple of weeks, the job blew up. We found ourselves stranded in Tulsa. First time I ever left home with a band. What year was that? That was around 1923. And after that job blew up, we were sitting around in Tulsa trying to get a job…
That must have been one of the first New Orleans bands in that part of the country.
